'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[Israel–Hamas war]]
***[[2023 Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]] 
****Seven [[Israeli Ground Forces|Israeli troops]] are killed in clashes in the [[Gaza Strip]], bringing the total number of [[Israel Defense Forces|IDF]] personnel [[killed in action]] to 104. ***[[International reactions to the Israel–Hamas war]]
****[[Egypt]] and [[Mauritania]] invoke [[United Nations General Assembly Resolution 377|United Nations Resolution 377]] for the [[UN General Assembly]] to discuss an immediate humanitarian [[ceasefire]] at an emergency session in [[New York City]], in response to the [[United States]] [[United Nations Security Council veto power|vetoing]] a [[United Nations Security Council resolution|UN resolution]] with a similar objective. **[[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]], [[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)]]
***An Israeli [[artillery]] strike kills the mayor of [[Taybeh (Marjaayoun)|Taybeh]], [[Marjeyoun District]], [[Lebanon]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-shelling-kills-mayor-lebanese-village-2023-12-11/ (Reuters)]
*[[Mali War]]
**[[MINUSMA]] officially departs [[Mali]] after ten years of [[United Nations peacekeeping|peacekeeping]] in the country. The two remaining MINUSMA bases in [[Gao]] and [[Timbuktu]] are expected to end operations before MINUSMA's mandate expires on December 31. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/12/11/un-peacekeeping-mission-in-mali-officially-ends-after-10-years (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Myanmar civil war (2021–present)|Myanmar civil war]]
**Representatives from [[Myanmar]]'s ruling [[State Administration Council|military junta]] hold talks with [[Three Brotherhood Alliance|three rebel groups]], facilitated by [[China]], amid an [[Operation 1027|ongoing rebel offensive]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/myanmar-military-meets-rebel-groups-with-chinas-help-junta-spokesperson-2023-12-11/ (Reuters)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[List of military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War|Military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War]]
***Representatives of [[Prime Minister of Hungary]] [[Viktor Orbán]] meet with [[United States]] [[Republican Party (United States)|Republicans]] in [[Washington, D.C.|Washington]] to discuss ending [[European Union|EU]] and [[United States|US]] military support to Ukraine. [https://www.wionews.com/world/viktor-orbans-allies-to-meet-with-us-republicans-on-halting-ukraine-aid-668304 (WION)]
***The [[United Kingdom]] announces that it will donate two [[Royal Navy]] [[Sandown-class minehunter|''Sandown''-class minehunter]]s to [[Ukraine]]. Doubts are raised over the [[logistics]] and timing of their arrival, with [[Turkey]] controlling access to the [[Black Sea]] through the [[Bosphorus]].  [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-67676029 (BBC News)]
**[[United States]] [[United States Senate|Senator]] [[JD Vance]] says that Ukraine should be [[Concessions and leases in international relations|willing to give up]] part of its territory to end the [[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|war]]. Vance and other Republicans have opposed the aid package proposed in the [[United States Congress]] for [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2023/dec/11/republican-senator-jd-vance-ukraine-cede-land-russia-war-invasion (The Guardian)]
*[[Yemeni civil war (2014–present)|Yemeni civil war]]
**''M/T Strinda'', a Norwegian-owned [[chemical tanker]], is hit by at least one [[missile]] launched from [[Yemen]], with the vessel reportedly in flames in the [[Red Sea]]. The [[USS Mason (DDG-87)|USS ''Mason'']] is responding to a distress call from the ship, according to U.S. officials. [https://www.thedrive.com/the-war-zone/commercial-ship-in-flames-after-red-sea-missile-attack (The Drive)]
